prompt:
Create ONE high-resolution game ASSET MODELING REFERENCE SHEET, not a map, for the Battle Cities environment replacement pack. Image 1 is the selected STYLE TARGET: copy its polished chunky beveled low-poly toy 3D treatment, convincing sculpted volume, warm cream walls, rich blue/coral roofs, navy recesses, small gold utility lights and restrained silver detail. Other images, if present, are original stage art references only. Keep the same family styling. Neutral ivory background, no environment, no UI decoration. Clean soft short shadows and bright upper-left studio light; no grunge, no noisy photo textures, no black outline drawing, no flat striped boxes.

LAYOUT: TWO COLUMNS. LEFT is a generous elevated front-left THREE-QUARTER MODELING VIEW showing real depth, south/front faces the viewer. RIGHT is the EXACT SAME ASSET rendered TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC FROM DIRECTLY ABOVE, with parallel edges and NO visible front wall, NO perspective taper, NO camera tilt. North points UP on the right-hand top view. Every row is one asset, two matching views, not two variants. Clearly label the two columns '3/4 MODEL' and 'TOP • NORTH ↑'. Under each row place only its supplied short identifier, name and footprint. No long annotations or extra objects.

All dimensions refer to the complete X-by-Z footprint in Unity units; 64 logical game units = 1 Unity unit. Show a faint footprint rectangle under each top view, subdivided into 1-unit grid cells; artwork stays INSIDE it. No roof, foliage, doorstep, vent, beam, support or trim may cross the assigned footprint. Use the grid as a size guide, not as a thick pedestal base. Model objects with enough clearance from the bounds. Details should be broad and legible when these assets occupy 1–3 cells on a top-down gameplay map. Do not invent new mechanics, interactive objects, logos, signs, lettering on buildings or gameplay effects. No existing brick/steel wall or tank/eagle asset redesign. Output a clean complete uncropped sheet.

Exactly TWO ROWS. These are low traversable surface-detail assets, NOT rectangular raised plates or walls. G1 mud covers an irregular organic region WITHIN 3x2 footprint, shallow warm dark-brown wet soil, two broad subtle tread ruts, a few small subdued puddles, feathered edge thinning to zero, maximum displacement .025 unit; no reeds, logs, stones taller than soil or deep trench. G2 rubble covers an irregular sparse region within 2x1, mixed warm-orange broken brick chips and cool grey stone fragments, with clear ground gaps and at most .12 unit piece height; 8-12 broad pieces, not a boulder mound or solid strip. Three-quarter views show how shallow both are. Top views show the exact same rut/debris placement. No surrounding roads or walls, no artificial tile plinth, no extra collision objects. Keep the empty surrounding ground neutral cream and the footprint grid faint. The visual patch may be irregular, but the reserved gameplay effect rectangle stays as specified.

ROW ORDER AND SHORT LABELS:
1. G1 MUD PATCH • 3×2. Visual model notes: Irregular shallow warm-brown wet earth with two subtle tread ruts, feathered ground edge and restrained puddles; no rectangular raised slab. Maximum suggested height 0.025 units.
2. G2 RUBBLE PATCH • 2×1. Visual model notes: Sparse low orange brick chips and cool stone fragments with clear gaps; traversable, nothing resembling a tall barrier. Maximum suggested height 0.12 units.

Use a high-resolution SQUARE sheet, clear navy headings and enough space between rows. Only supplied short labels; do not print long manifest IDs or instructions. The exact footprint grid and the view-to-view shape consistency matter more than embellishment.
LIGHTING OVERRIDE: no emissive materials on these props/terrain; no real-time lights. Yellow marks are ordinary paint. Only building windows elsewhere may emit warm light.
role: Multi-view asset modeling concept sheet, not a texture or a finished 3D mesh
normalization: Original generated PNG copied unchanged; embedded metadata retained
